descriptions.preferred: Acer saccharum Apollo® Barrett Cole Columnar Maple Zones 3-8 Apollo® Sugar Maple is a narrow, columnar selection of Sugar Maple prized for its dense branching and compact habit, making it ideal for tight urban and residential spaces where a traditional Sugar Maple would outgrow its setting. In 10 years, it typically reaches about 20–25 ft tall and 8–10 ft wide, maintaining a refined, upright form. Its dark green foliage handles summer heat well before turning a brilliant mix of fall color when planted in full sun. Adaptable to most soils, including slightly alkaline sites, it prefers well-drained conditions and should be kept out of compacted or salt-exposed areas. As a semi-dwarf cultivar, it grows at a moderate pace and is better suited for vertical interest, screening, or tall hedging rather than broad shade coverage. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer saccharum Apollo® Barrett Cole 柱形槭，适生区 3-8。 Apollo® Sugar Maple 是糖槭的狭柱形选育品种，以分枝紧密、株型紧凑而受到重视，特别适合传统糖槭会显得过大的狭小城市与住宅空间。 10 年内通常可长至约 20-25 英尺高、8-10 英尺宽，保持精致而直立的树形。 其深绿色叶片具有较好的夏季耐热性，在全日照条件下栽培时，秋季可转为绚丽的综合色彩。 对多数土壤均有适应性，包括微碱性土壤，但更偏好排水良好的环境，应避免种植在土壤板结或有盐害暴露的位置。 作为半矮生品种，其生长速度中等，更适合作为竖向景观焦点、屏障种植或高篱材料，而非提供大面积遮荫。 此规格为 10 加仑容器苗，仅支持本地自提，因植株过大无法邮寄。 MrMaple Nursery 位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，请联系我们安排提货时间。
